title: Victoria Sponge Cake
description: A classic British dessert consisting of two light and fluffy sponge cakes sandwiched together with raspberry jam and buttercream.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C). Grease two 8-inch round cake pans.
Cut the British sponge into two equal pieces.
In a large mixing bowl, cream together the butter and sugar until light and fluffy.
Beat in the eggs one at a time.
Spoon half of the batter into each prepared cake pan.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Allow the cakes to cool in the pans for 5 minutes before transferring them to a wire rack to cool completely.
Once the cakes are completely cool, spread a layer of raspberry jam on top of one of the cakes.
Top with the second cake and dust with powdered sugar.
